calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, remove the daily cross-sectional median return to isolate idiosyncratic/common-move residuals, accumulate the residual over five sessions, and reverse it after scaling by its trailing 20-session residual volatility. Higher values indicate stronger risk-normalized residual underperformance and a contrarian long signal. The signal uses only information available through the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across the full sample and both broad halves (0.04255 in 2020-2027 and 0.00482 in 2027-2034); the latter is weaker, so uncertainty and regime decay should be monitored conservatively.
validation.methodology: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC; dates with at least 8 valid instruments; 4,530 dates and 15 instruments available. ICIR is mean daily IC divided by its sample standard deviation times square-root of observation count.
